verdict.rationale: This is a skill/prompt bundle installed into agents, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server (for example, one exposing the skills as prompts or tools) is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows distribution only through plugin marketplaces (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) and the `npx skills` file installer. Nothing documents an MCP server, so the verdict is none.
